data.title: Graphene oxide/metal–organic framework composite as an effective catalyst for esterification reactions
data.author: Reza Masoudi, Ali Zarnegaryan, Zahra Dehbanipour
data.summary: Abstract Herein, we report the synthesis and characterization of graphene oxide (GO) impregnated into a Zr-based metal–organic framework (MOF-801), denoted as MOF-801@GO, as a catalyst for esterification reactions. The synthesized catalyst was thoroughly characterized using various techniques, including Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, Brunauer–Emmett–Teller (BET) surface area measurements, and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and inductively coupled plasma (ICP) spectroscopy. The surface acid strength was evaluated by ammonia temperature-programmed desorption (NH₃-TPD). The catalytic performance of MOF-801@GO was assessed in the esterification of carboxylic acids with alcohols using no solvent. Under optimized reaction conditions, the catalyst achieved a high esterification yield of up to 95%. Notably, the catalyst was readily recovered and reused over multiple cycles with minimal loss of catalytic activity or structural integrity, highlighting its promise for practical esterification applications.
data.title_cn: 氧化石墨烯/金属有机骨架复合材料作为酯化反应的有效催化剂
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 在此，我们报道了浸渍到锆基金属有机骨架（MOF-801）中的氧化石墨烯（GO）的合成和表征，表示为MOF-801@GO，作为酯化反应的催化剂。使用各种技术对合成的催化剂进行了彻底的表征，包括傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱、Brunauer-Emmett-Teller（BET）表面积测量、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、热重分析（TGA）、X射线衍射（XRD）和电感耦合等离子体（ICP）光谱。通过氨程序升温脱附(NH3-TPD)评价表面酸强度。 MOF-801@GO 的催化性能在不使用溶剂的羧酸与醇的酯化反应中进行了评估。在优化的反应条件下，该催化剂实现了高达95%的酯化收率。值得注意的是，该催化剂很容易回收并在多个循环中重复使用，催化活性或结构完整性的损失最小，凸显了其在实际酯化应用中的前景。

data.title: Electromagnetic shielding performance and mechanical properties of vermiculite-based lightweight geopolymer mortars
data.author: Ali İhsan Çelik, Ufuk Tunç, Ali Durmuş, Ercan Karaköse, Fatih Özkan Alkurt, Muharrem Karaaslan
data.summary: In recent years, the widespread use of electronic devices has led to an increase in electromagnetic pollution, which causes electromagnetic interference and reduces the performance of systems. Furthermore, increasing electromagnetic pollution can pose serious risks to human health. This study investigates the development of vermiculite-reinforced lightweight geopolymer composites for protection against electromagnetic pollution. The composites were produced using F-class fly ash and vermiculite in varying proportions between 0 and 100%, along with 10–13 M NaOH solutions. The electromagnetic performance of the 160 × 140 × 40 mm tablet samples is evaluated by measuring S11, S21, and shielding effectiveness (SE) for 3–40 GHz frequency bands, 16 GHz and 32 GHz used as representative points for cross-property plots. While electromagnetic SE was characterized across the broad 3–40 GHz band, the frequencies of 16 GHz and 32 GHz are selected as representative points for detailed cross-property analysis and surface plotting to illustrate the interaction between mechanical and electromagnetic performance. All mixtures showed good impedance matching with reflection values below − 10 dB. SE results show that V25–M12, V50–M12, and V100–M12 mixtures, especially in the Ka band, provided high electromagnetic attenuation by exhibiting resonance peaks above 50 dB. The increase in vermiculite content reduced the bulk density by 8–17% due to its porous structure. Higher molarities (especially 13 M) created a looser microstructure. The highest mechanical flexural strength (8.9 MPa) is obtained with 25% vermiculite and 11 M solution, while the highest compressive strength (30–32 MPa) is obtained with the vermiculite-free control sample. Taguchi analysis showed that the combination of 25% vermiculite and 11–13 M NaOH provided the most balanced mechanical and electromagnetic performance.
data.title_cn: 蛭石基轻质地质聚合物砂浆的电磁屏蔽性能及力学性能
data.abstract_cn: 近年来，电子设备的广泛使用导致电磁污染的增加，造成电磁干扰，降低系统的性能。此外，日益严重的电磁污染会给人类健康带来严重风险。本研究研究了用于防止电磁污染的蛭石增强轻质地质聚合物复合材料的开发。该复合材料是使用 0 至 100% 之间不同比例的 F 级粉煤灰和蛭石以及 10-13 M NaOH 溶液生产的。通过测量 3-40 GHz 频段的 S11、S21 和屏蔽效能 (SE) 来评估 160 × 140 × 40 mm 片剂样品的电磁性能，其中 16 GHz 和 32 GHz 用作交叉特性图的代表点。虽然电磁SE在3-40 GHz宽频带上进行了表征，但选择16 GHz和32 GHz频率作为详细交叉特性分析和曲面图的代表点，以说明机械和电磁性能之间的相互作用。所有混合物均表现出良好的阻抗匹配，反射值低于 − 10 dB。 SE 结果表明，V25–M12、V50–M12 和 V100–M12 混合物（尤其是在 Ka 频段）通过表现出高于 50 dB 的谐振峰值来提供高电磁衰减。由于其多孔结构，蛭石含量的增加使堆积密度降低了 8-17%。较高的摩尔浓度（尤其是 13 M）会产生较松散的微观结构。使用 25% 蛭石和 11 M 溶液获得最高的机械弯曲强度（8.9 MPa），而使用不含蛭石的对照样品获得最高的压缩强度（30-32 MPa）。田口分析表明，25% 蛭石和 11-13 M NaOH 的组合提供了最平衡的机械和电磁性能。

data.title: Motion-robust myelin imaging in MRI using 1D projection gating
data.author: Jinil Park, Sam Sedaghat, Kader Karli Oguz, Youngkyoo Jung, Eddie Fu, Nian Wang, Fang Liu, Hyungseok Jang
data.summary: Myelin-weighted imaging with inversion-recovery ultrashort-echo-time (IR-UTE) is highly motion-sensitive, yet extra hardware or longer scans are impractical. We evaluated whether a 1D superior–inferior (SI) navigator with bit-reversed spoke-angles mitigates motion artifacts without extending acquisition. Dual-echo IR-UTE was implemented at 3T. After an adiabatic inversion pulse, 21 spokes were acquired per segment around the white-matter null point, and dual-echo subtraction suppressed residual long-T2 signals. Adding SI-navigators at the end of each segment allows motion detection without lengthening TR. And bit-reversal is used to pseudo-randomize the spoke-angles. Bloch simulations of a 2D synthetic brain removed 10% of spokes to mimic gating. Three volunteers were scanned: (i) sequential-ordering, no-motion; (ii) bit-reversed, no-motion; (iii) bit-reversed with deliberate head nods. The navigator rejected 1,280 of 12,000 spokes (10.7%) during nodding, and the same gating was reconstructed on motion-free data. Simulation showed coherent streaks for sequential ordering but an isotropic point-spread function for bit-reversal. In vivo, gating degraded only the sequential dataset. bit-reversal preserved subcortical and deep-white-matter detail. During intentional nodding, gating with bit-reversal enhanced myelin contrast, outperforming the image reconstructed from the ungated data. The SI-navigator plus bit-reversal enables effective motion gating without hardware or time penalty, supporting routine motion-robust myelin mapping.
data.title_cn: 使用一维投影门控在 MRI 中进行运动鲁棒性髓磷脂成像
data.abstract_cn: 具有反转恢复超短回波时间 (IR-UTE) 的髓磷脂加权成像具有高度运动敏感性，但额外的硬件或更长的扫描是不切实际的。我们评估了具有位反转辐条角度的一维上下 (SI) 导航器是否可以在不扩展采集范围的情况下减轻运动伪影。双回波 IR-UTE 在 3T 下实施。绝热反转脉冲后，白质零点周围每段采集 21 个辐条，并且双回波减法抑制了残留的长 T2 信号。在每个段的末尾添加 SI 导航器可以在不延长 TR 的情况下进行运动检测。位反转用于伪随机化辐条角度。 Bloch 对 2D 合成大脑的模拟去除了 10% 的辐条以模拟门控。对三名志愿者进行了扫描：（i）按顺序排列，不运动； (ii) 位反转，无运动； (iii) 反转并故意点头。导航器在点头过程中拒绝了 12,000 个辐条中的 1,280 个（10.7%），并且在无运动数据上重建了相同的门控。仿真显示顺序排序具有相干条纹，但位反转具有各向同性点扩散函数。在体内，门控仅降低了顺序数据集。位反转保留了皮质下和深层白质细节。在有意点头期间，使用位反转的门控增强了髓磷脂对比度，优于从非门控数据重建的图像。 SI-navigator 加上位反转可实现有效的运动门控，无需硬件或时间损失，支持常规运动鲁棒性髓磷脂映射。

data.title: Eco-friendly synthesis of star-shaped Zn nanoparticles using Beta vulgaris peel extract and evaluation of their antibacterial, photocatalytic, and cytotoxic activities
data.author: Faeghe Sadat Mousavi Khatat, Zahra Sabouri, Majid Darroudi
data.summary: In this study, for the first time, Zn nanoparticles were created using the root peel of Beta vulgaris by a green method. Synthesized Zn nanoparticles have been characterized via UV–Vis spectroscopy, Zeta potential analysis, XRD, FTIR, TEM, and FESEM-EDX techniques. The synthesis of zinc-based nanoparticles was confirmed by spectroscopic techniques. UV-Vis analysis presented a broad absorption peak in the UV region, centered around 300 nm. Furthermore, a zeta potential of − 21.6 mV characterized the particles’ negative surface charge and suggested moderate colloidal stability. The XRD pattern of Zn nanoparticles revealed crystalline structures, and FESEM and TEM images of Zn nanoparticles displayed a star-shaped morphology. The photocatalytic activity of NPs for the color degradation of Rhodamine B (RhB) and Methylene Blue (MB) dyes has been investigated under UV light, and the results show 97% and 98% degradation, respectively. The antibacterial activity of the Zn nanoparticles was evaluated at a concentration of 1 mg/mL against the gram-positive bacterium Staphylococcus aureus (ATCC 1112 and clinical isolates), Enterococcus faecalis (ATCC and clinical isolates), and gram-negative bacterium Escherichia coli (ATCC and clinical isolates) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (PAO1 and S7). The cytotoxic effects of Zn nanoparticles were assessed over a concentration range of 7 to 500 µg/mL on both normal L929 fibroblast cells and MCF-7 breast cancer cells. After 24 h of incubation, the IC₅₀ value for the MCF-7 cell line was determined to be 284 µg/mL, while no significant cytotoxicity was observed on L929 cells. To our understanding, this is the initial report synthesizing star-shaped Zn nanoparticles utilizing B. vulgaris root peel as an eco-friendly reducing and stabilizing agent, highlighting their potential for environmental and biomedical applications.
data.title_cn: 使用甜菜皮提取物环保合成星形锌纳米粒子并评估其抗菌、光催化和细胞毒活性
data.abstract_cn: 在这项研究中，首次利用绿色方法利用甜菜根皮制备了纳米锌颗粒。合成的 Zn 纳米颗粒已通过 UV-Vis 光谱、Zeta 电位分析、XRD、FTIR、TEM 和 FESEM-EDX 技术进行了表征。通过光谱技术证实了锌基纳米粒子的合成。 UV-Vis 分析在 UV 区域呈现出宽吸收峰，中心位于 300 nm 附近。此外，- 21.6 mV 的 zeta 电位表征了颗粒的负表面电荷，表明具有中等的胶体稳定性。 Zn 纳米粒子的 XRD 图显示了晶体结构，Zn 纳米粒子的 FESEM 和 TEM 图像显示出星形形貌。在紫外光下研究了纳米粒子对罗丹明 B (RhB) 和亚甲基蓝 (MB) 染料颜色降解的光催化活性，结果显示分别降解 97% 和 98%。在浓度为 1 mg/mL 时，评估了 Zn 纳米颗粒对革兰氏阳性菌金黄色葡萄球菌（ATCC 1112 和临床分离株）、粪肠球菌（ATCC 和临床分离株）、革兰氏阴性菌大肠杆菌（ATCC 和临床分离株）和铜绿假单胞菌（PAO1 和 S7）的抗菌活性。在 7 至 500 µg/mL 的浓度范围内，评估了 Zn 纳米颗粒对正常 L929 成纤维细胞和 MCF-7 乳腺癌细胞的细胞毒性作用。孵育24小时后，MCF-7细胞系的IC50值为284μg/mL，而对L929细胞没有观察到明显的细胞毒性。据我们了解，这是利用普通芥子根皮作为环保还原剂​​和稳定剂合成星形锌纳米粒子的初步报告，凸显了其在环境和生物医学应用中的潜力。

data.title: Simulated depression risk classification from Parkinson’s voice features using a self-attention-enhanced MLP architecture
data.author: Nalineekumari Arasavali, Mohammed. Ashik, Vaddadi Nirmal, Mogadala Vinod Kumar, U Siddaraj
data.summary: Parkinson’s disease affects both motor and non-motor functions, including vocal features that may indicate underlying mental health conditions such as depression. This work proposes a novel framework for simulated depression risk classification using vocal biomarkers derived from the UCI Parkinson’s dataset. A Self-Attention-Enhanced Multilayer Perceptron-MLP architecture is used model interactions between key acoustic features, particularly Harmonic-to-Noise Ratio and Jitter, which serve as the basis for generating binary depression risk labels. The proposed model outperforming traditional and deep learning benchmarks including Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), TabNet, CNN-LSTM, Deep Neural Network (DNN), and Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM) with an accuracy of 97%, F1-score of 98%, recall of 95%, and specificity of 100%, While EBM offers strong interpretability, the attention-enhanced model demonstrates optimal predictive capability. These findings highlight the efficacy of voice-based features combined with attention mechanisms for early, non-invasive identification of depression risk in PD patients.
data.title_cn: 使用自我注意增强 MLP 架构根据帕金森语音特征进行模拟抑郁症风险分类
data.abstract_cn: 帕金森病会影响运动和非运动功能，包括可能表明抑郁等潜在心理健康状况的声音特征。这项工作提出了一种使用源自 UCI 帕金森数据集的声音生物标志物进行模拟抑郁症风险分类的新框架。自注意力增强型多层感知器 MLP 架构用于关键声学特征之间的交互模型，特别是谐波噪声比和抖动，它们是生成二元抑郁症风险标签的基础。所提出的模型优于传统和深度学习基准，包括支持向量机 (SVM)、k-近邻 (k-NN)、TabNet、CNN-LSTM、深度神经网络 (DNN) 和可解释增强机 (EBM)，准确度为 97%，F1 分数为 98%，召回率为 95%，特异性为 100%。虽然 EBM 提供了强大的可解释性，但注意力增强模型表现出最佳的预测能力。这些发现强调了基于语音的特征与注意力机制相结合对于早期、非侵入性识别 PD 患者抑郁风险的功效。

data.title: Correlation of chronological, skeletal and dental (Demirjian method) ages in an Iranian growing orthodontic population – a cross-sectional study
data.author: Mehraneh Mohammadian-Rastani, Fatemeh Gorjizadeh, Seyedeh Roghayeh Panahi, Ali Mousavizadeh
data.summary: Growth modification treatments are a type of orthodontic treatment used for patients who are still growing. The treatment plan and timing for these interventions are generally based on the chronological age of patients; however, achieving the most desirable outcome requires a thorough understanding of the physical development of children and adolescents. The aim of this study is to examine the correlation between chronological age and physical development in children and adolescents requiring orthodontic treatment. To assess physical development, both dental age and skeletal age were evaluated. Panoramic and lateral cephalometric radiographs of 194 orthodontic patients aged 7 to 17 years were randomly selected from a dental clinic in Gachsaran. Dental maturity was assessed using the Demirjian method, while skeletal maturity was evaluated using the cervical vertebral maturation stage (CVMS) method described by Baccetti. Data analysis was conducted using SPSS software version 27. The correlation between variables was calculated using Pearson’s correlation coefficient and Spearman’s rank correlation. The mean dental age of patients was found to be higher than their chronological age. Notably, the strongest correlation between dental age and chronological age for both males and females were observed at the first cervical vertebral maturation stage (CVMS1) highlighting its potential clinical relevance for early growth assessment. The positive Pearson correlation between dental age and chronological age was 0.894 in males and 0.876 in females. Moreover, a strong and significant positive correlation was found between dental age and skeletal age, with a Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient of 0.779 in males and 0.785 in females. Additionally, a strong and significant positive correlation was observed between chronological age and skeletal age, with a Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient of 0.783 in males and 0.707 in females. The results of this study indicate a significant positive correlation between chronological age and both methods of assessing physical development (dental age and skeletal age). The Demirjian method appears to overestimate dental age in the study population, suggesting a need to reassess its validity in Iranian population. Furthermore, the strongest correlation between chronological age and dental age was observed at the CVMS1 for both genders. These insights should be taken into account when planning growth modification treatments.
data.title_cn: 伊朗不断增长的正畸人群中实际年龄、骨骼年龄和牙齿年龄（Demirjian 方法）的相关性——一项横断面研究
data.abstract_cn: 生长调节治疗是一种用于仍在生长的患者的正畸治疗。这些干预措施的治疗计划和时间通常基于患者的实际年龄；然而，要实现最理想的结果，需要透彻了解儿童和青少年的身体发育情况。本研究的目的是探讨需要正畸治疗的儿童和青少年的实际年龄与身体发育之间的相关性。为了评估身体发育，评估了牙龄和骨骼年龄。从 Gachsaran 的一家牙科诊所随机抽取 194 名 7 至 17 岁正畸患者的全景和侧位头影测量 X 线照片。牙齿成熟度使用 Demirjian 方法评估，而骨骼成熟度使用 Baccetti 描述的颈椎成熟阶段 (CVMS) 方法评估。使用SPSS软件27版进行数据分析。使用Pearson相关系数和Spearman等级相关计算变量之间的相关性。研究发现，患者的平均牙科年龄高于实际年龄。值得注意的是，在第一颈椎成熟阶段（CVMS1）观察到男性和女性的牙齿年龄和实际年龄之间最强的相关性，突出了其对早期生长评估的潜在临床相关性。牙齿年龄与实际年龄之间的 Pearson 正相关性，男性为 0.894，女性为 0.876。此外，牙齿年龄和骨骼年龄之间存在强烈且显着的正相关性，男性的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数为0.779，女性的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数为0.785。此外，实足年龄与骨龄之间存在强烈且显着的正相关性，男性的 Spearman 等级相关系数为 0.783，女性的 Spearman 等级相关系数为 0.707。这项研究的结果表明，实际年龄与评估身体发育的两种方法（牙齿年龄和骨骼年龄）之间存在显着的正相关性。 Demirjian 方法似乎高估了研究人群的牙齿年龄，这表明需要重新评估其在伊朗人群中的有效性。此外，在两性的 CVMS1 中观察到实际年龄和牙龄之间最强的相关性。在规划生长调节治疗时应考虑这些见解。

data.title: Enhanced interhemispheric functional connectivity in elderly anxiety patients with long-term benzodiazepine use: an fNIRS study
data.author: Yiheng Chang, Meichen Liu, Yudan Liu, Xueting Xie, Huimin Zhang
data.summary: Individuals with anxiety exhibit high clinical usage of benzodiazepines, particularly among those with long-term use, yet the impact of these medications on cognitive function remains inconclusive. Previous research has predominantly focused on epidemiological data and metabolic measurements, often overlooking both cortical activation and the synchrony between different brain regions. This study investigates how brain neuronal activities are modulated in both long-term benzodiazepine users and nonusers during cognitive tasks, offering insights into the neural mechanisms underlying cognitive function. Fifty older adults with anxiety disorders participated in this study, including 31 long-term benzodiazepine users (BZD group) and 19 nonusers (control group). Functional near-infrared spectroscopy was used to assess cortical activation and functional connectivity during a verbal fluency task. Our study is the first to find a greater interhemispheric functional connectivity in chronic benzodiazepine users. However, no notable differences were detected between the two groups regarding behavioral performance, cortical activation, or changes in oxygenated hemoglobin concentration. Moreover, cumulative dosage of benzodiazepines use had no significant effect on dorsolateral prefrontal cortex activation. Long-term benzodiazepines use does not affect brain activation but impacts functional connectivity. The increased interhemispheric connectivity may serve to maintain the stability of brain networks, and this enhanced connectivity could be associated with the long-term adaptive disinhibition of GABAergic neurotransmission.
data.title_cn: 长期使用苯二氮卓类药物的老年焦虑患者半球间功能连接增强：一项 fNIRS 研究
data.abstract_cn: 焦虑症患者临床上经常使用苯二氮卓类药物，尤其是长期使用的患者，但这些药物对认知功能的影响仍不确定。之前的研究主要集中在流行病学数据和代谢测量上，往往忽视了皮质激活和不同大脑区域之间的同步性。这项研究调查了长期服用苯二氮卓类药物和非服用苯二氮卓类药物的人在执行认知任务期间大脑神经元活动如何受到调节，从而深入了解认知功能背后的神经机制。 50 名患有焦虑症的老年人参与了这项研究，其中包括 31 名长期服用苯二氮卓类药物（BZD 组）和 19 名非服用者（对照组）。功能性近红外光谱用于评估言语流畅性任务期间的皮质激活和功能连接。我们的研究首次发现长期服用苯二氮卓类药物的人大脑半球间的功能连接性更强。然而，两组之间在行为表现、皮质激活或氧合血红蛋白浓度变化方面没有发现显着差异。此外，苯二氮卓类药物的累积剂量对背外侧前额叶皮层的激活没有显着影响。长期使用苯二氮卓类药物不会影响大脑激活，但会影响功能连接。半球间连接的增加可能有助于维持大脑网络的稳定性，并且这种增强的连接可能与 GABA 能神经传递的长期适应性去抑制有关。

data.title: Physics-guided machine learning framework for RCA concrete by experimental database, modelling, and statistical validation
data.author: Mohamed Abdikarin Mohamud, Muhannad Riyadh Alasiri, Nebi Özdöner, Sadık Alper Yıldızel, Yasin Onuralp Özkılıç
data.summary: The search for sustainable construction materials has increased the use of recycled concrete aggregate (RCA); however, variability in mechanical performance and the absence of accurate forecasting tools limit its utilization. A complete laboratory program utilized RCA from six parent strength classes (C5–C50) and three particle-size fractions (0–4 mm, 5–11 mm, 12–22 mm) at 10%–50% replacement levels. The mechanical performance of concrete incorporating RCA is strongly influenced by the aforementioned parameters. This study proposes a physics-guided machine learning (ML) framework to predict the compressive strength (CS) and splitting tensile strength (STS) of RCA concrete, explicitly addressing data sparsity and RCA-induced variability. A comprehensive experimental database covering multiple RCA replacement levels, particle-size fractions, and parent concrete strength classes was established, and gradient-boosting models (XGBoost and LightGBM) were trained using a physics-guided data augmentation strategy in which synthetic samples were generated within physically admissible bounds derived from experimental variability. The model’s performance was assessed using R², RMSE, and MAE, with supplementary error stratification across RCA regimes. The results show that the proposed framework achieves strong predictive accuracy and stable performance, with RMSE values remaining within ranges considered acceptable experimentally, even at higher RCA replacement levels. The accompanying statistical analyses confirm that the observed reductions in strength associated with increasing RCA content are both statistically significant and physically meaningful. Compared with conventional augmentation approaches, the physics-guided strategy improves model robustness in sparsely populated regions of the dataset without introducing non-physical relationships. As a result, the framework provides a transparent, physically consistent machine-learning approach for data-driven mixture design and the development of sustainable concrete systems.
data.title_cn: 通过实验数据库、建模和统计验证构建 RCA 混凝土物理引导机器学习框架
data.abstract_cn: 对可持续建筑材料的追求增加了再生混凝土骨料（RCA）的使用；然而，机械性能的可变性和缺乏准确的预测工具限制了其使用。完整的实验室计划使用来自六个母体强度等级 (C5–C50) 和三个粒径级分（0–4 毫米、5–11 毫米、12–22 毫米）的 RCA，替换水平为 10%–50%。掺有 RCA 的混凝土的机械性能受到上述参数的强烈影响。本研究提出了一种物理引导的机器学习 (ML) 框架来预测 RCA 混凝土的抗压强度 (CS) 和劈裂抗拉强度 (STS)，明确解决数据稀疏性和 RCA 引起的变异性问题。建立了涵盖多个 RCA 替代水平、粒度分数和母体混凝土强度等级的综合实验数据库，并使用物理引导的数据增强策略训练梯度增强模型（XGBoost 和 LightGBM），其中在源自实验可变性的物理允许范围内生成合成样本。使用 R²、RMSE 和 MAE 评估模型的性能，并在 RCA 体系中进行补充误差分层。结果表明，所提出的框架具有很强的预测准确性和稳定的性能，即使在较高的 RCA 替代水平下，RMSE 值仍保持在实验可接受的范围内。随附的统计分析证实，观察到的与 RCA 含量增加相关的强度降低既具有统计显着性，又具有物理意义。与传统的增强方法相比，物理引导策略提高了数据集稀疏区域中的模型鲁棒性，而无需引入非物理关系。因此，该框架为数据驱动的混合物设计和可持续混凝土系统的开发提供了一种透明的、物理一致的机器学习方法。

data.title: Effects of single and mixed metal exposure on neurocognitive health and quality of life among adults from Bihar India
data.author: V. Udaya Kumar, Krishna Pandey, Arun Kumar, Nitesh Kumar, Ruckmani Kandasamy, Krishna Murti
data.summary: Cognitive decline due to environmental exposure to metals and metalloids is a global public health concern because of their potential neurotoxic effects. While individual metal exposures have been linked to cognitive impairment, the effects of simultaneous and combined exposures remain inconclusive. This cross-sectional study was conducted among the adults residing in Bihar state to evaluate the burden of beryllium (Be), vanadium (V), chromium (Cr), cobalt (Co), arsenic (As), selenium (Se), strontium (Sr), silver (Ag), cadmium (Cd), caesium (Cs), barium (Ba), lead (Pb), and uranium (U) metals and their individual and mixed associations. Cognitive and quality of life scores were assessed using the MoCA and the WHO-QoL Brief questionnaire. The log-transformed metal and metalloid concentrations were inversely correlated with the cognitive scores (ρ -0.29 to -0.78) and HR-QoL scores (ρ > -0.5; P < 0.05). The cognitive scores were directly associated with the QoL domains (ρ > 0.5; P < 0.05). The metals As, V, Co, Se, Cs, and U had a strong negative influence on cognitive scores (β > -2.5; P < 0.05). The AENT model revealed As, Co, and Cr as the most influential metals on the cognitive score, where the combined effect of multiple metals and metalloids on cognitive impairment was (β = -5.75 (-6.68, -4.81) (P < 0.001). This highlights the individual and joint detrimental impacts of metals and metalloids on cognitive decline and poor HR-QoL, emphasising the need for clinical biomonitoring of metal exposure.
data.title_cn: 单一和混合金属暴露对印度比哈尔邦成年人神经认知健康和生活质量的影响
data.abstract_cn: 由于环境中接触金属和类金属而导致的认知能力下降是一个全球性的公共卫生问题，因为它们具有潜在的神经毒性作用。虽然单独的金属暴露与认知障碍有关，但同时和联合暴露的影响仍不确定。这项横断面研究是在比哈尔邦的成年人中进行的，旨在评估铍 (Be)、钒 (V)、铬 (Cr)、钴 (Co)、砷 (As)、硒 (Se)、锶 (Sr)、银 (Ag)、镉 (Cd)、铯 (Cs)、钡 (Ba)、铅 (Pb) 和铀的负担(U) 金属及其单独和混合组合。使用 MoCA 和 WHO-QoL Brief 问卷评估认知和生活质量评分。对数转换后的金属和类金属浓度与认知评分（ρ -0.29 至 -0.78）和 HR-QoL 评分（ρ > -0.5；P < 0.05）呈负相关。认知得分与生活质量直接相关（ρ > 0.5；P < 0.05）。金属 As、V、Co、Se、Cs 和 U 对认知得分有强烈的负面影响（β > -2.5；P < 0.05）。 AENT 模型显示，As、Co 和 Cr 是对认知评分影响最大的金属，其中多种金属和类金属对认知障碍的综合影响为 (β = -5.75 (-6.68, -4.81) (P < 0.001)。这凸显了金属和类金属对认知能力下降和 HR-QoL 较差的个体和联合有害影响，强调了对金属暴露进行临床生物监测的必要性。

data.title: CiCLoDS: Joint cell clustering and gene selection for single-cell spatial transcriptomics
data.author: Nuozhou Wang, Yimeng He, Edward Ray, Kyoung Jae Won, Curtis L Cetrulo, Debiao Li, Jason H Moore, Shuzhong Zhang, Xiuzhen Huang
data.summary: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomic (ST) assays now profile targeted gene panels for hundreds of thousands of cells while preserving tissue context, yet most downstream analyses still need a compact, interpretable subset. We introduce CiCLoDS (Clustering in Critical & Low-Dimensional Subspace), an unsupervised framework adapted for spatial transcriptomics to jointly optimize clustering and feature selection under a strict, user-defined gene budget. The method returns an explicit feature subset aligned with the discovered partitions, accepts spatial side information via sine–cosine positional encodings, and converges in minutes on commodity CPUs. We benchmark CiCLoDS on three diverse datasets: Vizgen MERFISH mouse liver (1.27 M cells), 10x Xenium human colon (23 K cells), and Human DLPFC. On hepatocyte zonation, CiCLoDS raises the adjusted Rand index by up to +0.36 over PCA and geneBasis, preserves neighborhood structure with a kNN-overlap AUC of 0.89, and detects vessel-associated voids at 92.8% F1. On Human DLPFC (Visium), CiCLoDS demonstrates robust generalization, achieving a mean Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) of 0.40—surpassing BayesCafe (0.32)—and maintaining high accuracy on heterogeneous samples where baselines fail. Furthermore, we reveal a synergistic utility: using CiCLoDS to initialize BayesSpace raises the mean ARI to 0.50, resolving local minima issues to outperform either method alone. These results show that a lightweight, jointly optimized objective can achieve competitive accuracy, robust generalization, and synergistic utility while producing assay-ready feature panels.
data.title_cn: CiCLoDS：单细胞空间转录组学的联合细胞聚类和基因选择
data.abstract_cn: 基于成像的空间转录组 (ST) 测定现在可以分析数十万个细胞的目标基因组，同时保留组织背景，但大多数下游分析仍然需要一个紧凑的、可解释的子集。我们引入了 CiCLoDS（关键和低维子空间聚类），这是一种适用于空间转录组学的无监督框架，可在严格的、用户定义的基因预算下联合优化聚类和特征选择。该方法返回与发现的分区对齐的显式特征子集，通过正弦余弦位置编码接受空间辅助信息，并在几分钟内在商用 CPU 上收敛。我们在三个不同的数据集上对 CiCLoDS 进行基准测试：Vizgen MERFISH 小鼠肝脏（1.27 M 细胞）、10x Xenium 人类结肠（23 K 细胞）和人类 DLPFC。在肝细胞分区方面，CiCLoDS 将调整后的 Rand 指数比 PCA 和 GeneBasis 提高了高达 +0.36，以 0.89 的 kNN 重叠 AUC 保留邻域结构，并以 92.8% F1 检测血管相关空隙。在人类 DLPFC (Visium) 上，CiCLoDS 表现出强大的泛化能力，平均调整兰德指数 (ARI) 达到 0.40，超过 BayesCafe (0.32)，并在基线失败的异质样本上保持高精度。此外，我们还揭示了一个协同实用程序：使用 CiCLoDS 初始化 BayesSpace 将平均 ARI 提高到 0.50，解决了局部最小值问题，其性能优于单独使用任何一种方法。这些结果表明，轻量级、联合优化的物镜可以实现有竞争力的准确性、强大的泛化性和协同效用，同时生成可用于分析的特征面板。

data.title: Boosting visible-light photocatalysis with MWCNT-modified TiO2/SiO2/g-C3N4: efficient tetracycline removal in pure and hard water
data.author: Samira Mohammaddarvish, Amir Ali Masoudi, Zahra Sadat Hosseini
data.summary: Abstract In this study, we present a facile synthesis of a TiO 2 /SiO 2 /g-C 3 N 4 /MWCNT composite with dual functionality as both a photocatalyst and adsorbent for the effective elimination of pharmaceutical and dye pollutants from water. The composite was comprehensively characterized using FESEM, EDX, XRD, BET, FTIR, PL, and UV–Vis spectroscopy to elucidate its morphology, crystalline structure, and optical properties. The results revealed a hierarchical flower-like sphere/sheet architecture with an average crystallite size of about 21.3 nm. Multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) acted as visible-light photosensitizers, enhancing the separation efficiency of photogenerated electron–hole pairs. The influence of MWCNT content on photocatalytic activity was systematically investigated. The TiO 2 /SiO 2 /g-C 3 N 4 /MWCNT composite with 11 wt% CNT demonstrated superior visible-light degradation performance, achieving 92% efficiency for a 20 mg/L methylene blue (MB) aqueous solution significantly outperforming the MWCNT-free counterpart. Furthermore, the presence of MWCNTs remarkably improved tetracycline (TC) removal in CaCO 3 -rich water (20 mg/L TC with 300 mg/L CaCO 3 ). The high photocatalytic activity is attributed to the formation of abundant local junctions among g-C 3 N 4 , TiO 2 /SiO 2 , and MWCNTs, which facilitate efficient charge separation and migration through a direct Z-scheme mechanism under visible light illumination.
data.title_cn: 利用 MWCNT 修饰的 TiO2/SiO2/g-C3N4 增强可见光光催化作用：有效去除纯水中和硬水中的四环素
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：在本研究中，我们提出了一种简单合成的TiO 2 /SiO 2 /g-C 3 N 4 /MWCNT 复合材料，该复合材料具有光催化剂和吸附剂的双重功能，可有效消除水中的药物和染料污染物。使用 FESEM、EDX、XRD、BET、FTIR、PL 和 UV-Vis 光谱对复合材料进行了全面表征，以阐明其形貌、晶体结构和光学性能。结果揭示了分层的花状球/片结构，平均晶粒尺寸约为 21.3 nm。多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为可见光光敏剂，提高光生电子空穴对的分离效率。系统研究了MWCNT含量对光催化活性的影响。含有 11 wt% CNT 的 TiO 2 /SiO 2 /g-C 3 N 4 /MWCNT 复合材料表现出优异的可见光降解性能，在 20 mg/L 亚甲基蓝 (MB) 水溶液中实现了 92% 的效率，明显优于不含 MWCNT 的对应物。此外，MWCNT 的存在显着改善了富含 CaCO 3 的水中四环素 (TC) 的去除（20 mg/L TC 与 300 mg/L CaCO 3 ）。高光催化活性归因于g-C 3 N 4 、TiO 2 /SiO 2 和MWCNT之间形成丰富的局部结，这有助于在可见光照射下通过直接Z型机制实现有效的电荷分离和迁移。

data.title: Engineered biosynthesis of hyaluronic acid in Corynebacterium glutamicum and green synthesis of HA-silver nanocomposites for advanced antimicrobial wound dressings
data.author: Mahdieh Nadali Hazaveh, Saeed Salehi, Marjan Talebi, Rouzbeh Almasi Ghale, Hamid Zilouei, Fatemeh Tabandeh
data.summary: Antibiotic resistance, a growing global challenge, is predicted to cause millions of deaths in the near future. Innovative antibacterial wound dressings loaded with natural substances that have restorative effects can serve as alternatives conventional medicine. This research aims to investigate the antibacterial properties of electrospun nanofibers containing different proportions of chitosan, collagen, and hyaluronic acid-silver nanocomposite. Silver nanoparticles (Ag NPs) were synthesized via a green, solvent‑free method, with hyaluronic acid (HA) obtained from recombinant Corynebacterium glutamicum fermentation serving as the natural reducing agent. with its production optimized using a full factorial design, resulting in a 26% yield increase under conditions of 10 g/L yeast extract, 20 g/L soy protein, and 400 mg/L MgSO₄. The purity of HA obtained from microbial fermentation was measured by Fourier-Transform Infrared spectroscopy. Silver nitrate concentrations of 0.01, 0.1, and 1 M were considered to synthesize nanoparticle precursors. Spectrophotometry and Dynamic Light Scattering analyses showed that 0.1 M AgNO3 produced nanoparticles with an average size of 98.5 nm. Scanning Electron Microscopy revealed that the nanofibers had a coherent and uniform structure. Antibacterial activity was evaluated against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. Nanofibers with 1:1:1 and 0.5:1:1 ratios (HA-Ag: collagen: chitosan) inhibited S. aureus growth, producing inhibition zones of 1.4 cm and 1.0 cm, respectively, but showed no effect against E. coli. Cytotoxicity assessment using L929 fibroblast cells through MTT assay indicated cell viabilities of approximately 85% and 70% for the active formulations, suggesting acceptable biocompatibility. Overall, the developed nanocomposite-loaded nanofibers show potential for application against antibiotic-resistant wound infections caused by Gram-positive bacteria.
data.title_cn: 谷氨酸棒杆菌中透明质酸的工程生物合成以及用于先进抗菌伤口敷料的HA-银纳米复合材料的绿色合成
data.abstract_cn: 抗生素耐药性是一个日益严峻的全球挑战，预计在不久的将来将导致数百万人死亡。创新的抗菌伤口敷料含有具有恢复作用的天然物质，可以作为传统药物的替代品。本研究旨在研究含有不同比例的壳聚糖、胶原蛋白和透明质酸-银纳米复合材料的静电纺纳米纤维的抗菌性能。以重组谷氨酸棒杆菌发酵获得的透明质酸（HA）作为天然还原剂，通过绿色、无溶剂的方法合成纳米银（Ag NPs）。采用全因子设计优化生产，在 10 g/L 酵母提取物、20 g/L 大豆蛋白和 400 mg/L MgSO₄ 的条件下，产量提高了 26%。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱测量微生物发酵获得的HA的纯度。 0.01、0.1 和 1 M 的硝酸银浓度被认为可合成纳米颗粒前体。分光光度法和动态光散射分析表明，0.1 M AgNO3 产生平均尺寸为 98.5 nm 的纳米颗粒。扫描电子显微镜显示纳米纤维具有连贯且均匀的结构。评估了对大肠杆菌和金黄色葡萄球菌的抗菌活性。比例为 1:1:1 和 0.5:1:1 的纳米纤维（HA-Ag：胶原蛋白：壳聚糖）可抑制金黄色葡萄球菌生长，分别产生 1.4 cm 和 1.0 cm 的抑制区，但对大肠杆菌没有效果。通过 MTT 测定使用 L929 成纤维细胞进行的细胞毒性评估表明，活性制剂的细胞活力约为 85% 和 70%，表明具有可接受的生物相容性。总体而言，所开发的纳米复合材料负载的纳米纤维显示出用于对抗革兰氏阳性菌引起的耐抗生素伤口感染的潜力。

data.title: Comprehensive phytochemical, anatomical and biological evaluation of Ziziphora clinopodioides Lam. (Lamiaceae), used as a traditional tea from Türkiye
data.author: Ömer Çeçen
data.summary: Abstract This study provides a comprehensive investigation of Ziziphora clinopodioides Lam. (Lamiaceae) from Türkiye, focusing on its phytochemical composition, biological activities, and anatomical characteristics relevant to its potential as a functional food ingredient. Methanol and aqueous extractions yielded 28.09% and 30.91%, respectively, calculated based on the dry weight of the plant material. Essential oil analysis identified 98.3% of the total composition, with oxygenated monoterpenes, particularly 1,8-cineole (28.2%), terpinen-4-ol (12.0%), and pulegone (7.9%), as dominant constituents. Enzyme inhibition assays revealed α-amylase inhibition of 29.3% by the essential oil, calculated based on the tested sample concentration, and moderate cholinesterase inhibition by the methanolic extract; however, all activities were lower than those of the reference drugs. Morphological analysis confirmed the plant as a mat-forming perennial with dense hirsuteness and capitate inflorescences. Leaf anatomy showed amphistomatic, bifacial structure with diverse trichome types and a well-organized vascular system. The stem anatomy exhibited a quadrangular structure with varied glandular and non-glandular trichomes, developed collenchyma, and a distinct endodermis. The findings of this research could shed light on the medicinal value of Z. clinopodioides , and open up new possibilities for its use in various food products or therapeutic applications.
data.title_cn: Ziziphora clinopodioides Lam 的综合植物化学、解剖学和生物学评价。 （唇形科），用作土耳其的传统茶
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 本研究对 Ziziphora clinopodioides Lam 进行了全面调查。来自土耳其的唇形科植物，重点关注其植物化学成分、生物活性以及与其作为功能性食品成分潜力相关的解剖特征。根据植物材料的干重计算，甲醇和水提取的产率分别为 28.09% 和 30.91%。精油分析确定了 98.3% 的总成分，其中含氧单萜，特别是 1,8-桉树脑 (28.2%)、萜品烯-4-醇 (12.0%) 和胡薄荷酮 (7.9%) 为主要成分。酶抑制测定显示，根据测试样品浓度计算，精油对 α-淀粉酶的抑制率为 29.3%，甲醇提取物对胆碱酯酶的抑制率为中度；然而，所有活性均低于参考药物的活性。形态分析证实该植物是一种席状多年生植物，具有浓密的多毛和头状花序。叶子解剖结构显示出双生、双面结构，具有不同的毛状体类型和组织良好的维管系统。茎解剖结构呈现四边形结构，具有不同的腺毛和非腺毛、发达的厚角组织和明显的内皮层。这项研究的结果可以揭示 Z. clinopodioides 的药用价值，并为其在各种食品或治疗应用中的使用开辟新的可能性。

data.title: Exploring gene expression as a sublethal endpoint in gammarids exposed to pesticides: insights from next-generation sequencing
data.author: Dominik Züger, Boris Kolvenbach, Timm Hettich, Miriam Langer, Verena Christen
data.summary: Pesticide residues are frequently detected in surface waters, with several compounds known to adversely affect aquatic organisms. Gammarids are particularly suitable indicator organisms for assessing the sublethal effects of such contaminants due to their high sensitivity and their central ecological role in freshwater ecosystems. While behavioral endpoints and feeding rates have been commonly used to evaluate sublethal pesticide effects, gene expression changes have received comparatively little attention, despite their proven value in other ecotoxicological contexts. This study investigates the potential of gene expression as a sensitive sublethal endpoint in gammarids collected from natural populations. A laboratory exposure experiment was conducted using the model pesticides azoxystrobin and acetamiprid, both of which are regularly detected in surface waters. Gammarids collected from the wild were exposed under controlled conditions to sublethal concentrations of the test substances. Subsequently, RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed to characterize genome-wide transcriptional responses. Two independent exposure and sequencing experiments were carried out, resulting in the identification of 145 and 326 differentially expressed transcripts per experiment when comparing exposed animals to controls. Gene ontology (GO) term enrichment analyses revealed significant effects on metabolic processes, cell proliferation, and cell differentiation. Notably, the two experimental runs yielded distinct transcriptional profiles, with minimal overlap in differentially expressed transcripts despite the use of gammarids from the same population and the short interval (12 days) between experiments. The study demonstrates the applicability of transcriptomic analyses for detecting sublethal pesticide effects in field-collected gammarids and provides a practical workflow for the evaluation of RNA-seq data in non-model organisms. At the same time, it highlights important limitations, including high genetic variability within wild populations and incomplete transcriptome annotation, which together contribute to inconsistencies across repeated experiments.
data.title_cn: 探索基因表达作为暴露于农药的伽马的亚致死终点：来自下一代测序的见解
data.abstract_cn: 地表水中经常检测到农药残留，其中几种化合物已知会对水生生物产生不利影响。由于其高敏感性及其在淡水生态系统中的核心生态作用，伽马科动物是特别适合评估此类污染物的亚致死影响的指示生物。虽然行为终点和进食率通常用于评估亚致死农药效应，但基因表达变化相对较少受到关注，尽管它们在其他生态毒理学背景下已被证明具有价值。本研究调查了基因表达作为从自然种群中收集的伽马病毒中敏感的亚致死终点的潜力。使用模型农药嘧菌酯和啶虫脒进行了实验室暴露实验，这两种农药经常在地表水中检测到。从野外收集的伽马科动物在受控条件下暴露于亚致死浓度的测试物质。随后，进行 RNA 测序 (RNA-seq) 来表征全基因组转录反应。进行了两次独立的暴露和测序实验，当将暴露的动物与对照进行比较时，每个实验鉴定出 145 和 326 个差异表达的转录本。基因本体 (GO) 术语富集分析揭示了对代谢过程、细胞增殖和细胞分化的显着影响。值得注意的是，这两个实验运行产生了不同的转录谱，尽管使用来自同一群体的伽马并且实验之间的间隔很短（12天），但差异表达转录本的重叠最小。该研究证明了转录组分析在检测现场采集的伽马射线中亚致死农药效应的适用性，并为评估非模式生物中的 RNA-seq 数据提供了实用的工作流程。与此同时，它强调了重要的局限性，包括野生种群内的高遗传变异性和不完整的转录组注释，这些共同导致了重复实验的不一致。

data.title: Effects of Trichoderma harzianum and Azospirillum brasilense on tomato growth, fruit quality, yield, and water productivity under deficit irrigation
data.author: Ayoub Ghorbani Dehkordi, Kambiz Mashayekhi, Seyyed Javad Mousavizadeh, Kamran Rahnama
data.summary: Abstract This study evaluated tomato plants’ physiological and biochemical changes influenced by the Trichoderma harzianum and the Azospirillum brasilense . This study aimed to determine whether microbial inoculation with T. harzianum and A. brasilense can mitigate water-deficit stress and improve tomato growth, yield, and crop water productivity under different irrigation regimes. The irrigation regime was applied at four levels: no irrigation, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the water requirement (WR), and biological fertilizer was applied in four treatments: control, Trichoderma, Azospirillum, and Trichoderma + Azospirillum. The experiment was conducted as a factorial design, and the effects of irrigation regime and biological fertilizer treatments were statistically significant for most measured traits. The results demonstrated that the highest fresh and dry root weights and leaf area, were observed under the 100% WR combined with the application of biological fertilizers, particularly Trichoderma . Additionally, chlorophyll content was higher under a 100% WR with biological fertilizers. In contrast, The highest contents of carotenoids (22%), anthocyanins (18%), glucose (79%), sucrose (96%), and total sugars (121%) in leaves were observed under no-irrigation conditions. Conversely, the assessment of fruit characteristics revealed that the highest fresh and dry fruit weights, fresh fruit yield and Wp were achieved under the 100% WR combined with applying biological fertilizers, particularly Trichoderma . Azospirillum treatment and combining Trichoderma with Azospirillum achieved the lowest levels of fruit firmness, total soluble solids, and anthocyanin in fruits under a 100% WR. Moreover, the Trichoderma treatment was able to achieve similar performance under 75% WR conditions as the control treatment under 100% WR. Overall, the results indicate that Trichoderma inoculation plays a key role in improving tomato physiological performance and water productivity under different irrigation regimes, with potential implications for sustainable water management.
data.title_cn: 哈茨木霉和巴西固氮螺菌对缺水灌溉下番茄生长、果实品质、产量和水分生产率的影响
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 本研究评估了哈茨木霉和巴西固氮螺菌对番茄植株生理生化变化的影响。本研究旨在确定在不同灌溉制度下，微生物接种哈茨木霉和巴西木霉是否可以缓解缺水胁迫并改善番茄生长、产量和作物水分生产率。灌溉方式分为四个级别：不灌溉、50%、75%和100%需水量（WR），并在四个处理中施用生物肥料：对照、木霉、固氮螺菌和木霉+固氮螺菌。该实验采用因子设计进行，灌溉制度和生物肥料处理的影响对于大多数测量的性状具有统计显着性。结果表明，在 100% WR 结合施用生物肥料（特别是木霉）的情况下，观察到最高的鲜根和干根重量以及叶面积。此外，在 100% WR 的生物肥料下，叶绿素含量更高。相比之下，在不灌溉条件下，叶子中类胡萝卜素（22％）、花青素（18％）、葡萄糖（79％）、蔗糖（96％）和总糖（121％）的含量最高。相反，对果实特性的评估表明，在100%WR结合施用生物肥料（尤其是木霉）下，鲜果重、干果重、鲜果产量和Wp达到最高。固氮螺菌处理以及木霉与固氮螺菌的组合在 100% WR 下实现了果实硬度、总可溶性固形物和花青素的最低水平。此外，木霉处理在 75% WR 条件下能够实现与对照处理在 100% WR 条件下相似的性能。总体而言，结果表明，木霉接种在不同灌溉方式下改善番茄生理性能和水生产率方面发挥着关键作用，对可持续水管理具有潜在影响。

data.title: Experimental investigation on solar air heating system using evacuated tube collector with coaxial tube
data.author: Venkatramanan Ravichandran, P. Manoj Kumar, Veerakumar Adaikalasamy, Dawit Tafesse Gebreyohannes
data.summary: Solar energy is a widely accessible, eco-friendly, and sustainable way to fulfil the global expanding energy needs. Solar air heaters are used in a variety of solar energy applications, including space heating, timber seasoning, and agricultural drying. The present work aimed to evaluate the performance of an evacuated tube solar air heater with coaxial tube by varying the mass flow rate of air and length of the coaxial tube at climatic conditions of Coimbatore, India. The experimental setup comprises of header, 20 evacuated tube solar collector and blower. Atmospheric air made to flow through the coaxial mild steel tubes under forced convection. The 1.5 m coaxial tube heated air to a maximum of 94 °C when we ran it at 50 kg/h, achieving 26% effective thermal efficiency. Meanwhile, the shorter 0.75 m tube reached 78 °C at the same flow rate but performed slightly better with effective thermal efficiency of 28%. It is concluded that the outlet air temperature is strongly dependent on the flow rate, coaxial tube length and solar intensity. Temperature range attained by this solar air heater is suitable for many solar thermal applications in small and medium scale industries.
data.title_cn: 同轴管真空管集热器太阳能空气采暖系统实验研究
data.abstract_cn: 太阳能是一种广泛使用、环保且可持续的方式，可以满足全球不断增长的能源需求。太阳能空气加热器用于各种太阳能应用，包括空间供暖、木材调味和农业干燥。目前的工作旨在通过在印度哥印拜陀的气候条件下改变空气的质量流量和同轴管的长度来评估具有同轴管的真空管太阳能空气加热器的性能。实验装置包括集管、20个真空管太阳能集热器和鼓风机。大气在强制对流下流过同轴低碳钢管。当我们以 50 kg/h 的速度运行时，1.5 m 同轴管将空气加热到最高 94 °C，实现了 26% 的有效热效率。与此同时，较短的 0.75 m 管在相同流量下达到 78 °C，但性能稍好，有效热效率为 28%。结论是，出口空气温度很大程度上取决于流量、同轴管长度和太阳强度。该太阳能空气加热器达到的温度范围适用于中小型工业中的许多太阳能热应用。

data.title: Age-dependent efficiency of magnetic drug targeting in young and old patient-specific aortic models
data.author: Seyed Behzad Hosseini, Wala Almosawy, Rasoul Karimi Takrami, Negar Abdi, Saman Aminian
data.summary: Magnetic drug targeting (MDT) offers a non-invasive and localized approach for improving therapeutic delivery in vascular diseases, but its efficiency is strongly affected by age-related hemodynamic changes. In this study, a computational framework was employed to compare MDT performance in young and old patient-specific aortic models reconstructed from clinical imaging. Blood was modeled using non-Newtonian Carreau, Power-law, and Casson-Papanastasiou rheologies, while nanoparticle motion was simulated under external magnetic fields ranging from 0.5 to 1.5 T. Across all rheological models, capture efficiency (CE) increased with particle size and magnetic field intensity. Importantly, older patients consistently exhibited slightly higher CE than younger patients, a trend driven by their reduced flow velocity, enlarged aortic lumen, and lower wall shear stress, which collectively prolonged nanoparticle residence time and reduced hydrodynamic drag opposing magnetic capture. For example, under a 1.5 T field using the Carreau model, CE reached 8.7% for 1000 nm particles in both young and old patients, but at intermediate intensities (0.5–1.25 T), older patients showed higher CE (e.g., 2.4% vs. 2.1% at 0.5 T, and 7.3% vs. 6.6% at 1.25 T). Newtonian rheology consistently over-predicted CE relative to non-Newtonian models. All applied magnetic field strengths remained within clinically acceptable safety thresholds, and field localization coincided with the target region of interest. These findings demonstrate that vascular aging enhances magnetophoretic drug capture under realistic hemodynamic conditions and underscore the need for age-aware optimization in patient-specific MDT strategies.
data.title_cn: 年轻和老年患者特异性主动脉模型中磁性药物靶向的年龄依赖性效率
data.abstract_cn: 磁药物靶向（MDT）为改善血管疾病的治疗提供了一种非侵入性的局部方法，但其效率受到与年龄相关的血流动力学变化的强烈影响。在这项研究中，采用计算框架来比较从临床成像重建的年轻和老年患者特异性主动脉模型中的 MDT 性能。使用非牛顿 Carreau、幂律和 Casson-Papanastasiou 流变学对血液进行建模，同时在 0.5 至 1.5 T 的外部磁场下模拟纳米颗粒的运动。在所有流变模型中，捕获效率 (CE) 随着颗粒尺寸和磁场强度的增加而增加。重要的是，老年患者始终表现出比年轻患者略高的CE，这是由流速降低、主动脉腔扩大和壁剪切应力降低驱动的，这些因素共同延长了纳米颗粒的停留时间并减少了与磁捕获相反的流体动力阻力。例如，在使用 Carreau 模型的 1.5 T 场下，年轻患者和老年患者中 1000 nm 粒子的 CE 均达到 8.7%，但在中等强度（0.5-1.25 T）下，老年患者表现出更高的 CE（例如，0.5 T 时为 2.4% 与 2.1%，1.25 T 时为 7.3% 与 6.6%）。相对于非牛顿模型，牛顿流变学始终高估 CE。所有施加的磁场强度均保持在临床可接受的安全阈值内，并且场定位与感兴趣的目标区域一致。这些发现表明，血管老化可增强现实血流动力学条件下磁泳药物捕获，并强调在患者特异性 MDT 策略中进行年龄感知优化的必要性。

data.title: Artificial neural network modeling and optimization of an electrochemical biosensor for plasma miR-155-based breast cancer detection
data.author: Aydin Imani, Soleiman Hosseinpour, Mostafa Azimzadeh, Amar Salehi
data.summary: MicroRNA-155 (miR-155) is a clinically important biomarker involved in cancer progression, immune regulation, and inflammatory diseases, highlighting the need for sensitive and reliable detection methods. Conventional biosensor fabrication often relies on labor-intensive trial-and-error optimization, which delays the development of practical diagnostic tools. In contrast to most previous studies that focus on predicting analyte concentration from biosensor signals, this work develops a data-driven framework for modeling the nonlinear relationships between fabrication parameters and biosensor output. Artificial neural networks (ANN) and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems (ANFIS) were proposed to model a voltammetric biosensor for plasma miR-155 detection. A dataset containing the biosensor output current and six fabrication parameters was used. The optimal parameter values were determined using a genetic algorithm (GA). The results show that the ANN approach outperforms ANFIS, achieving an $$R^2$$ value of 0.9845. The optimal fabrication parameters were 7.12 nM, 85.22 min, 6.54 min, 118.02 min, 0.12 mM, and 93.39 min for detection probe concentration, detection probe incubation time, MCH incubation time, hybridization time, OB concentration, and OB incubation time, respectively, resulting in an output current of 223 nA. The ANN-GA framework offers a practical and efficient strategy for biosensor development by reducing experimental iterations, thereby lowering material consumption and enabling rapid parameter optimization. These findings demonstrate that ANN-assisted optimization can accelerate the development of cost-effective, high-performance biosensors, supporting their translation into clinical diagnostics for early and accurate miR-155 detection.
data.title_cn: 用于基于血浆 miR-155 的乳腺癌检测的电化学生物传感器的人工神经网络建模和优化
data.abstract_cn: MicroRNA-155 (miR-155) 是一种临床上重要的生物标志物，涉及癌症进展、免疫调节和炎症性疾病，凸显了对灵敏且可靠的检测方法的需求。传统的生物传感器制造通常依赖于劳动密集型的试错优化，这延迟了实用诊断工具的开发。与之前大多数专注于从生物传感器信号预测分析物浓度的研究相比，这项工作开发了一个数据驱动的框架，用于对制造参数和生物传感器输出之间的非线性关系进行建模。人工神经网络 (ANN) 和自适应神经模糊推理系统 (ANFIS) 被提议对用于血浆 miR-155 检测的伏安生物传感器进行建模。使用包含生物传感器输出电流和六个制造参数的数据集。使用遗传算法（GA）确定最佳参数值。结果表明，ANN 方法优于 ANFIS，$$R^2$$ 值为 0.9845。检测探针浓度、检测探针孵育时间、MCH孵育时间、杂交时间、OB浓度和OB孵育时间的最佳制作参数分别为7.12 nM、85.22 min、6.54 min、118.02 min、0.12 mM和93.39 min，输出电流为223 nA。 ANN-GA 框架通过减少实验迭代，为生物传感器开发提供了实用且高效的策略，从而降低材料消耗并实现快速参数优化。这些发现表明，ANN 辅助优化可以加速经济高效、高性能生物传感器的开发，支持将其转化为临床诊断，以实现早期准确的 miR-155 检测。

data.title: Photoinduced proton transfer in differently structured water: an EPR approach to solving a classic problem
data.author: Antonio Barbon, Anton Savitsky, Igor A. Grigoriev, Vladimir A. Reznikov, Igor A. Kirilyuk, Sofya Lushchekina, Ilia B. Moroz, Tamar Eliash, Noga Friedman, Mordehai Sheves, Raanan Carmieli, Lev Weiner
data.summary: The mechanism of proton transfer (PT), and how it is affected by water structure, is a fundamental issue in numerous chemical and biological processes. Formulated more than 200 years ago, a possible model for PT in aqueous media was proposed by Grotthuss, which continues to be actively studied and debated. In this study, we exploit electron paramagnetic resonance to investigate PT in aqueous solutions. Our proposed method employs pH-sensitive stable nitroxyl radicals and makes use of photolysis of 2-nitrobenzaldehyde to generate protons in the sub-nanosecond timescale. This approach was used to study the impact of classical chaotropic compounds on PT as studied in various aqueous solutions, i.e. 8 M urea, 6 M guanidine hydrochloride (Gdn·HCl), and potassium chloride (KCl). Our findings confirm significant impacts on PT rates. For instance, in 6 M Gdn·HCl, PT occurred 40-fold slower than in water. The method’s sensitivity to water structure is demonstrated, highlighting its potential for monitoring the kinetics of PT in ice and in proteins.
data.title_cn: 不同结构水中的光诱导质子转移：解决经典问题的 EPR 方法
data.abstract_cn: 质子转移（PT）的机制以及它如何受水结构的影响，是许多化学和生物过程中的一个基本问题。 Grotthuss 在 200 多年前提出了水介质中 PT 的可能模型，该模型仍在积极研究和争论。在这项研究中，我们利用电子顺磁共振来研究水溶液中的 PT。我们提出的方法采用 pH 敏感的稳定硝酰基自由基，并利用 2-硝基苯甲醛的光解在亚纳秒时间尺度内产生质子。该方法用于研究经典离液化合物对 PT 的影响，在各种水溶液中进行研究，即 8 M 尿素、6 M 盐酸胍 (Gdn·HCl) 和氯化钾 (KCl)。我们的研究结果证实了对 PT 率的显着影响。例如，在 6 M Gdn·HCl 中，PT 发生速度比在水中慢 40 倍。该方法对水结构的敏感性得到了证明，突出了其监测冰和蛋白质中 PT 动力学的潜力。

data.title: A polymer physics model of the interphase cell nucleus for radiobiological simulations
data.author: Man Zhao, Guomin Huang, Zi Xu, Xiaoyan Huang, Ying Liang
data.summary: Advances in chromatin architectures achieved through super-resolution imaging and high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C) techniques remain to be integrated into the modeling framework of radiobiology. In this study, the chromosomal and chromatin interactions in an interphase cell nucleus were described by polymer physics principles. To overcome the prohibitive computational cost, a multi-stage relaxation strategy was employed to decouple the relaxation processes of different structural levels. A distance-dependent DNA end rejoining model and a graph theory-based connected component analysis algorithm were implemented to simulate chromosome aberrations. Experimental measurements of chromosome aberrations in human skin fibroblasts exposed to both γ-rays and α particles were selected to benchmark the performance. The model efficiently reproduced 3D chromatin architectures, including chromosome territories and subcompartments, chromatin domains and loops. The predicted contact map and contact probability were consistent with Hi-C measurements. Model predicted dicentrics, interstitial deletions, and total aberrations aligned with experimental data within 20% for γ-rays and α particles, showing substantial improvement over previous reports. The proposed polymer physics-based model bridges structural biology and radiobiological simulations, demonstrating strong potential for accurate prediction of DNA damage and chromosome aberrations. Future refinements will integrate spatio-temporal repair dynamics and whole-genome sequencing data to enhance high-LET radiobiological effect predictions.
data.title_cn: 用于放射生物学模拟的间期细胞核的聚合物物理模型
data.abstract_cn: 通过超分辨率成像和高通量染色体构象捕获（Hi-C）技术实现的染色质结构的进步仍有待整合到放射生物学的建模框架中。在这项研究中，通过聚合物物理原理描述了间期细胞核中染色体和染色质的相互作用。为了克服高昂的计算成本，采用多阶段松弛策略来解耦不同结构级别的松弛过程。采用距离相关的 DNA 末端重新连接模型和基于图论的连通分量分析算法来模拟染色体畸变。选择暴露于 γ 射线和 α 粒子的人类皮肤成纤维细胞染色体畸变的实验测量来衡量性能。该模型有效地再现了 3D 染色质结构，包括染色体区域和子区室、染色质结构域和环。预测的接触图和接触概率与 Hi-C 测量结果一致。模型预测的双着丝粒、间质缺失和总像差与 γ 射线和 α 粒子的实验数据一致，误差在 20% 以内，与之前的报告相比，显示出显着的改进。所提出的基于聚合物物理的模型将结构生物学和放射生物学模拟联系起来，展示了准确预测 DNA 损伤和染色体畸变的强大潜力。未来的改进将整合时空修复动力学和全基因组测序数据，以增强高 LET 放射生物学效应预测。

data.title: Single cell RNA transcriptome response to fentanyl use in persons with HIV infection
data.author: Krishna M. Roskin, Heidi L. Meeds, Janani Madhuravasal Krishnan, Matthew Juhascik, John M. Cafardi, Jennifer L. Brown, Caroline Freiermuth, Michael S. Lyons, Kenneth E. Sherman, Jason T. Blackard
data.summary: The US is experiencing a major drug epidemic largely attributed to synthetic opioids including fentanyl. We considered how illicit fentanyl use in persons living with HIV impacted gene expression profiles in the peripheral blood. Whole blood was collected from 10 HIV-positive adults with a diagnosis of opioid use disorder (OUD) and 7 HIV-positive non-opioid using controls. Mean HIV viral loads were higher for the OUD+ group, although this difference did not reach statistical significance (2.44 versus 1.00 log10 copies/mL; p = 0.12; two-sample T test). 216,641 cells were evaluated by single cell RNAseq. Cell frequencies were not different by opioid status except for NK cells (lower for opioid use; p = 0.0045). For CD4+ T lymphocytes, 10 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were higher and 8 were lower in opioid-positive persons. In CD8+ T lymphocytes, there were 15 higher and 13 lower DEGs for opioid-positive study participants. In monocytes, 72 DEGs were higher and 37 DEGs were lower in opioid-positive participants. In B lymphocytes, 17 DEGs were higher and 10 were lower in opioid-positive versus opioid-negative participants. These findings highlight multiple pathways by which opioid use may contribute to HIV pathogenesis. Rigorous characterization of the interactions among HIV, opioids, and host cells can improve clinical management paradigms, facilitate rational public health policies, and reveal additional pathways for novel target-specific therapeutic interventions.
data.title_cn: HIV 感染者对芬太尼使用的单细胞 RNA 转录组反应
data.abstract_cn: 美国正在经历一场严重的毒品流行，很大程度上归因于包括芬太尼在内的合成阿片类药物。我们考虑了艾滋病毒感染者非法使用芬太尼如何影响外周血中的基因表达谱。从 10 名诊断为阿片类药物使用障碍 (OUD) 的 HIV 阳性成人和 7 名使用非阿片类药物的 HIV 阳性对照患者中采集全血。 OUD+ 组的平均 HIV 病毒载量较高，但这种差异未达到统计学显着性（2.44 对比 1.00 log10 拷贝/mL；p = 0.12；双样本 T 检验）。通过单细胞 RNAseq 评估了 216,641 个细胞。除 NK 细胞外，阿片类药物状态的细胞频率没有差异（阿片类药物使用较低；p = 0.0045）。对于 CD4+ T 淋巴细胞，阿片类药物阳性者中有 10 个差异表达基因 (DEG) 较高，8 个较低。在 CD8+ T 淋巴细胞中，阿片类药物阳性研究参与者有 15 个较高 DEG 和 13 个较低 DEG。在单核细胞中，阿片类药物阳性参与者的 72 DEG 较高，37 DEG 较低。在 B 淋巴细胞中，阿片类药物阳性参与者与阿片类药物阴性参与者相比，17 个 DEG 较高，10 个 DEG 较低。这些发现强调了阿片类药物的使用可能导致艾滋病毒发病机制的多种途径。对艾滋病毒、阿片类药物和宿主细胞之间相互作用的严格表征可以改善临床管理范式，促进合理的公共卫生政策，并揭示新的针对特定目标的治疗干预措施的其他途径。

data.title: Millisecond-level electrically switchable metalens for adaptive rotational depth mapping and diffraction-limited imaging
data.author: Yeseul Kim, Jihae Lee, Won-Sik Kim, Hyeonsu Heo, Dongmin Jeon, Beomha Yang, Xiaotong Li, Harit Keawmuang, Shiqi Hu, Young-Ki Kim, Trevon Badloe, Junsuk Rho
data.summary: We demonstrate an electrically tunable dual-mode metalens capable of polarization-sensitive focal control, combining high-resolution imaging and depth-sensing functionalities into a single compact device. By integrating hydrogenated amorphous silicon ( a -Si:H) meta-atoms with a liquid crystal (LC) modulator, the proposed metasurface independently manipulates left- and right-circularly polarized (LCP/RCP) incident light, generating a rotating double-helix focal distribution for LCP and an extended depth-of-focus (DOF) for RCP illumination. The meta-atoms were rigorously optimized using propagation and geometric phases, enabling precise phase control and high transmittance at a wavelength of 635 nm. Experimental characterization confirmed near-diffraction-limited lateral and axial resolutions, closely aligning with theoretical predictions. The integrated LC cell facilitates milliseconds polarizationswitching between depth-sensitive double-helix and high-resolution DOF imaging modes. We further verified depth-extraction capabilities by analyzing rotation angles from dual-image focal spots under mixed-polarization illumination. Depth-resolved imaging of a rubber-tree leaf, a skeletal-muscle cross-section, and a live planarian retrieved color-coded depths, demonstrating the effectiveness on complex biological tissues. This polarization-driven, electrically tunable metalens thus provides a versatile and effective optical platform suitable for advanced applications in biomedical imaging, three-dimensional sensing, adaptive optics, and compact imaging systems.
data.title_cn: 用于自适应旋转深度映射和衍射限制成像的毫秒级电切换超透镜
data.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一种电可调双模超透镜，能够进行偏振敏感焦点控制，将高分辨率成像和深度传感功能结合到一个紧凑的设备中。通过将氢化非晶硅 (a-Si:H) 超原子与液晶 (LC) 调制器集成，所提出的超表面独立操纵左旋和右旋圆偏振 (LCP/RCP) 入射光，为 LCP 生成旋转双螺旋焦点分布，并为 RCP 照明生成扩展焦深 (DOF)。使用传播和几何相位对超原子进行了严格优化，实现了精确的相位控制和 635 nm 波长下的高透射率。实验表征证实了接近衍射极限的横向和轴向分辨率，与理论预测紧密一致。集成的 LC 单元有助于在深度敏感双螺旋和高分辨率 DOF 成像模式之间进行毫秒级偏振切换。我们通过分析混合偏振照明下双图像​​焦点的旋转角度进一步验证了深度提取能力。橡胶树叶、骨骼肌横截面和活涡虫的深度分辨成像检索了颜色编码的深度，证明了对复杂生物组织的有效性。因此，这种偏振驱动的电可调超透镜提供了一个多功能且有效的光学平台，适用于生物医学成像、三维传感、自适应光学和紧凑型成像系统中的高级应用。

data.title: Ultra-sensitive multi-band infrared polarization photodetector based on 1T'-MoTe<sub>2</sub>/2H-MoTe<sub>2</sub> van der Waals heterostructure
data.author: Yuting Pan, Lidan Lu, Bofei Zhu, Chunhua An, Jing Yu, Guanghui Ren, Jian Zhen Ou, Mingli Dong, Zheng You, Lianqing Zhu
data.summary: Near infrared polarized photodetectors are widely used, and van der Waals heterostructures based on transition metal dichalcogenides are important platforms for device research and application. Homologous polymorphic two-dimensional chalcogenides refer to two-dimensional chalcogenides with the same chemical composition but different crystal structures. Homologous polymorphic two-dimensional chalcogenides have shown great potential in near-infrared detection due to their unique bandgap characteristics, exciton effects, and controllable optoelectronic properties. This paper studies a near-infrared polarized photodetector based on 1T'-MoTe 2 /2H-MoTe 2 structure, in which the semimetallic 1T'-MoTe 2 has attracted attention due to its low work function and excellent electrical performance. 1T'-MoTe 2 and 2H-MoTe 2 form a favorable bandgap structure after forming a heterojunction, which improves carrier separation efficiency and photoelectric response. This device exhibits excellent high-sensitivity optoelectronic detection performance in the wideband region (532–2200 nm), such as significant high responsivity (3.06 A·W –1 ) under 1310 nm laser, specific detectivity (3.2 × 10 9 Jones), good external quantum efficiency (289%), and fast rise and decay response times of 10.56 ms/6.26 ms. In addition, the device has polarization detection capability, achieving a high polarization sensitivity of 20.1. The device has successfully achieved imaging from visible light to near-infrared light, highlighting the potential of 1T'-MoTe 2 /2H-MoTe 2 heterojunction as a polarization sensitive detector.
data.title_cn: 基于1T'-MoTe 2 /2H-MoTe 2 范德华异质结构的超灵敏多波段红外偏振光电探测器
data.abstract_cn: 近红外偏振光电探测器应用广泛，基于过渡金属二硫化物的范德华异质结构是器件研究和应用的重要平台。同系多晶型二维硫族化物是指化学组成相同但晶体结构不同的二维硫族化物。同源多晶型二维硫属化物由于其独特的带隙特性、激子效应和可控光电特性，在近红外探测中显示出巨大的潜力。本文研究了一种基于1T'-MoTe 2 /2H-MoTe 2 结构的近红外偏振光电探测器，其中半金属1T'-MoTe 2 因其低功函数和优异的电性能而引起人们的关注。 1T'-MoTe 2 和2H-MoTe 2 形成异质结后形成良好的带隙结构，提高载流子分离效率和光电响应。该器件在宽带区域（532-2200 nm）表现出优异的高灵敏度光电探测性能，例如在1310 nm激光下显着高响应率（3.06 A·W –1 ）、比探测率（3.2 × 10 9 Jones）、良好的外量子效率（289%）以及10.56 ms/6.26 ms的快速上升和衰减响应时间。此外，该器件还具有偏振检测能力，实现了20.1的高偏振灵敏度。该器件成功实现了从可见光到近红外光的成像，凸显了1T'-MoTe 2 /2H-MoTe 2 异质结作为偏振敏感探测器的潜力。

data.title: Tunable compound eyes with coaxial lens-on-lens ommatidia for cooperative bi-focal imaging
data.author: Zhi-Juan Sun, Wei-Jian Zhong, Qing Cai, Yi-Fan Lu, Chang-Xu Li, Dong-Dong Han, Yong-Lai Zhang
data.summary: Compound eyes (CEs) offer a unique design paradigm for developing artificial micro-optical systems. However, current bionic CEs still fall significantly short of their insect counterparts in performance, particularly regarding ommatidial spatial arrangement, size distribution, visual field adaptability and environmental perception. Inspired by the CEs of Sympetrum frequens, we developed a tunable bionic CE with bi-focal ommatidia by integrating a flexible lens-on-lens (LoL) array with microfluidics, enabling simultaneous bi-focal imaging. The polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) LoL array was fabricated through sequential processing steps, including femtosecond laser dual-modification of quartz glass, two-step wet etching, and soft lithography using the resulting glass template. Integration of this flexible LoL array with a microfluidic chip produced a tunable CE with bi-focal ommatidia, allowing liquid-pressure modulation of CE configurations. We systematically investigated the optical performance of both LoL ommatidia and the integrated CE, including bi-focal focusing/imaging properties, tunable field-of-view (FOV), large-FOV imaging, and moving target monitoring. This tunable CE with LoL ommatidia demonstrates significant potential for cutting-edge applications.
data.title_cn: 具有同轴透镜对透镜小眼的可调谐复眼，用于协作双焦成像
data.abstract_cn: 复眼（CE）为开发人工微光学系统提供了独特的设计范例。然而，目前的仿生CE在性能方面仍明显低于昆虫同类，特别是在小眼空间排列、尺寸分布、视野适应性和环境感知方面。受 Sympetrum freques 的 CE 启发，我们通过将灵活的透镜叠加透镜 (LoL) 阵列与微流体集成，开发了一种具有双焦点小眼的可调谐仿生 CE，从而实现同时双焦点成像。聚二甲基硅氧烷 (PDMS) LoL 阵列是通过连续的处理步骤制造的，包括石英玻璃的飞秒激光双重改性、两步湿法蚀刻以及使用所得玻璃模板的软光刻。这种灵活的 LoL 阵列与微流控芯片的集成产生了具有双焦点小眼的可调 CE，允许对 CE 配置进行液压调制。我们系统地研究了 LoL 小眼和集成 CE 的光学性能，包括双焦聚焦/成像特性、可调视场 (FOV)、大 FOV 成像和运动目标监控。这种具有 LoL 小眼的可调 CE 展示了尖端应用的巨大潜力。

data.title: Pixelated BIC metasurfaces for terahertz integrated sensing and imaging
data.author: Zhanqiang Xue, Guizhen Xu, Junliang Chen, Junxing Fan, Hongyang Xing, Ye Zhou, Longqing Cong
data.summary: Conventional terahertz (THz) single-pixel imaging relies on a sequential process involving compressed sensing, which requires a spatial modulator and is often time-intensive. Here, we propose a new THz single-pixel imaging scheme operating in a parallelized fashion with a pixelated metasurface, demonstrated within a standard THz time-domain spectroscopy system. This approach encodes spatial information through multiple narrow linewidth resonances based on bound states in the continuum (BIC) physics, and the BIC-enabled pixelated metasurface facilitates the near-field distributed sensing through local field enhancement. We validate this integrated imaging and sensing capability using a 2×2 metasurface array in a proof-of-concept experiment, with scalability to larger arrays. The approach achieves 100% accuracy in binary imaging reconstruction from a single THz pulse and enables refractive index sensing with a sensitivity higher than 14.39 GHz/RIU. Leveraging the intrinsic penetration capability of THz radiation, this technique offers significant promise for next-generation noninvasive applications such as security inspection and defect detection in semiconductor chips and pharmaceutical products.
data.title_cn: 用于太赫兹集成传感和成像的像素化 BIC 超表面
data.abstract_cn: 传统的太赫兹（THz）单像素成像依赖于涉及压缩传感的顺序过程，这需要空间调制器并且通常非常耗时。在这里，我们提出了一种新的太赫兹单像素成像方案，以像素化超表面的并行方式运行，并在标准太赫兹时域光谱系统中进行了演示。这种方法通过基于连续体 (BIC) 物理中的束缚态的多个窄线宽共振对空间信息进行编码，并且支持 BIC 的像素化超表面通过局部场增强促进近场分布式传感。我们在概念验证实验中使用 2×2 超表面阵列验证了这种集成成像和传感功能，并可扩展至更大的阵列。该方法通过单个太赫兹脉冲实现了 100% 的二元成像重建精度，并实现了灵敏度高于 14.39 GHz/RIU 的折射率传感。利用太赫兹辐射的固有穿透能力，该技术为下一代非侵入性应用（例如半导体芯片和药品的安全检查和缺陷检测）提供了巨大的前景。
